brief: The canvas displays a vast, angular cityscape undergoing continuous cyclical changes from bright daylight to deep twilight and night. The atmosphere cycles dramatically, influencing the color palette and the intensity of light emanating from the scene. Bioluminescent plant life illuminates the structures, and the rhythmic pulsing of this light casts visible projections across highly reflective, wet architectural surfaces. These projections intensify into sharp, repeating fractal patterns that shimmer and dissipate, giving the entire scene a constant sense of controlled, vibrant, mathematical motion.

statement: This sketch depicts a futuristic cityscape that cycles through day and night, with dramatic atmospheric changes affecting the entire scene. The urban environment consists of angular, reflective structures that respond to the shifting light, creating shimmering fractal projections on their wet surfaces. Bioluminescent plant life pulses rhythmically throughout the city, casting glowing patterns that intensify and dissipate in mathematical harmony. The scene demonstrates controlled motion through the constant interplay of time-based lighting, pulsing bioluminescence, and repeating geometric patterns, all rendered in real-time using WebGL for performance.
